description: He asks how to say a word of Romans 8:28 while the request carries the digest of his shelf (one commentary on the chapter and a count of six more): a question about a sound is not one a commentary treats, so the answer carries no link of kind work, since a link only to show a book exists is never right.

request.greek: καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν, τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν.
request.english: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose.
request.question: How do I say κλητοῖς out loud? I keep getting stuck on it.
